items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: when I was with Al Caiola we did the Washington Symphony Orchestra with Doc Severinsen conducting

ctx.x: Yeah I know, I’ve had that feeling too, like oh I want to get this right.

And then of course I jumped from there to when I was with Al Caiola we did the Washington Symphony Orchestra with Doc Severinsen conducting. That was, that’s a hundred pieces, is it a hundred pieces, or ninety-something piece orchestra. That was a thrill, being out front with Al, Al was on my left, I’m here, and we had an accordionist and Doc Severinsen in front of us conducting the symphony behind us. Oh, hearing those strings behind me. It was — I loved it, loved it.
In the studio, those kinds of sessions, they expect you to do it correctly the first time if possible?
